description: Medical cash allowance for dependants at the contract's monthly amount, prorated by the calendar days the run covers over the month's days on every pay schedule, and not reduced for unpaid leave. Tax-free up to ₱1,500 a semester (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(c)); the excess counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit.

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (c): medical cash allowance to dependants to ₱1,500 a semester (₱250 a month): a de minimis benefit to the semester ceiling (January–June, July–December), the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_DEPENDANT_MEDICAL checkpoint. The per-month figure is the semester's sixth, so the semester ceiling governs either cadence.

description: Laundry allowance at the contract's monthly amount, paid by pay schedule: monthly, prorated by the period's calendar days over the month's days; twice a month, half each run; every ten days, a third each run. It is then reduced in the share of basic pay lost to unpaid leave and absences. Tax-free up to ₱300 a month (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(g)); the excess counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit.

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025, published 30 January 2025 and in force 14 February 2025, for uniforms and achievement awards) (g): laundry allowance to ₱300 a month: a de minimis benefit to the ceiling in each calendar month, the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_LAUNDRY checkpoint.
